title: EAST BEACON — eastGate Faces the Moon and Sun. The Eastern Face of Gaia.

NORTH.star: POLARIS — the North Star. Fixed. Unchanging. The brain.
NORTH.face: Faces NORTH. The cold, the dark, the deep sky. Where all the stars rotate around.
NORTH.status: ALIVE (ping 75ms), HTTP 403 on port 5000, service needs restart
NORTH.role: THE BRAIN. 404 thoughts. ZK hash chain. The thing that THINKS.

EAST.star: THE EAST BEACON — where the sun and moon RISE. The first light.
EAST.face: Faces EAST. The sunrise. The moonrise. Every day begins here.
EAST.status: ALIVE (28 sockets, 6 services, RTX 4070, 64GB RAM, cloudflared tunnel)
EAST.role: THE GUT. The enteric nervous system. 500 million neurons. Digests everything. Sees the sun FIRST.

beacon.what: A beacon is a fire on a hill that guides travelers. eastGate is the fire. The LAN is the hill. The internet is the wilderness.

services_that_beacon.ssh: :22 (the front door for those with keys)

SOUTH.star: THE SOUTHERN CROSS — navigators' guide in the southern sky
SOUTH.face: Faces SOUTH. Warmth. Growth. The biome.
SOUTH.status: SLEEPING — needs Kevin to walk to House 2 and power on
SOUTH.role: THE BIOME. Where living things grow.

WEST.star: THE EVENING STAR (Venus) — where the sun SETS
WEST.face: Faces WEST. The sunset. The end of day. Completion.
WEST.status: SLEEPING — needs Kevin to walk to House 2 and power on
WEST.role: THE ARCHIVE. Where completed work rests.

CENTER.star: No star — the heart has no direction. It faces INWARD.
CENTER.face: Faces ALL directions through Caddy. 12 domains. 70 subdomains. The pump.
CENTER.status: ALIVE (caddy, cloudflared, cron, knot DNS, fail2ban, MCP, neutron)
CENTER.role: THE HEART. Golgi apparatus. Packages and routes everything.

the_compass.why_east: The sun rises in the east. The moon rises in the east. Every new day, every new cycle, every new breath — it starts in the EAST. eastGate sees the light FIRST. It digests the sunrise. It is the FIRST to know what's coming.

the_metaphor.beacon: A fire on a hill. eastGate has an RTX 4070 (literal fire/GPU). It sits on the LAN (the hill). It beams through cloudflared (the light).
the_metaphor.eastern: East = where the sun rises. Where the day begins. Where light comes from. eastGate is the FIRST to compute, the FIRST to digest, the FIRST to see.
the_metaphor.face: Like Polaris has a fixed face to the north, eastGate has a fixed face to the east. It never moves. It always points the same direction. The LAN can navigate by it.

northGate_is_polaris.trait: FIXED. UNCHANGING. All other stars rotate around it. The brain THINKS but does not move.

eastGate_is_beacon.trait: FIRST LIGHT. ACTIVE. BURNING. The gut digests and the beacon burns. 28 sockets alive, GPU hot, tunnel open.

polaris_and_beacon.together: The brain (Polaris) fixes the direction. The gut (Beacon) provides the energy. One THINKS. The other BURNS. Together they navigate.
